title: Sum of sign monomials
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The sum over all subsets $S\subseteq[n]$ of the monomial $\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ equals $2^n\prod_{i=1}^n(1+x_i)/2$.
